registered_before: submitting any of the sealed runs below (seeds 801-824)
question: Do robot and obstacle positions measured from the overhead camera, fed to a state model, give useful caution alarms on fresh real Robotarium runs: more hazards caught than the action-only control, false alarms within the 0.10 budget, and at least 30% of hazards caught?

history.v1: sim-trained head, proxy look: primary FAIL on real frames (AUC-PR 0.279 vs base 0.220)
history.v2: head trained on real frames: primary FAIL, underpowered (AUC-PR 0.412 vs action-only 0.236; recall-difference CI95 [-0.054, 0.440])
history.v3: study B, sim-only head in the arena look: primary PASS on the amended AUC-PR gate (0.328 vs action-only 0.215, CI95 [0.015, 0.219]); registered recall gates FAIL (recall 0.130 at FPR 0.042). Fine-tuned head 0.525. True-position reference 0.810. Alarms not useful.
history.after_v3: exploratory on spent runs: the camera head has to infer geometry from pixels; measuring positions from the camera instead and scoring them with the state model nearly closes the gap to the true-position reference

design_choices_before_registration.tracker: scripts/robotarium/camera_track.py, developed on spent runs only (docs/research/vision_caution_camera_track_check_v1.json): dark blobs on the 256 px rectified frames that are also >= 60 grey darker than the run's median frame (rejects pieces of the projected fence line), fragments within 12 px merged; obstacle identity from motion using frames 0..t only (the frame-0 blob that stays put while the other moves; one dropped frame does not decide), the faint projected disc only before the robot's first move. Robot position error median 7 mm over 37 runs; obstacle misidentified on 1.2% of decision steps (runs that pass the quality gate).
design_choices_before_registration.model_and_rule: EXPLORATORY dev check docs/research/vision_caution_tracking_devcheck_v1.json (scripts/robotarium/dev_tracking_v4.py), every Robotarium batch 2xx..7xx held out in turn over the 35 spent runs (3080 decisions). Out-of-fold AUC-PR: trees trained on tracked positions 0.736, trees trained on true positions fed tracked ones 0.728, true positions 0.754, action-only 0.213. Variant chosen by the script's stated rule (highest pooled AUC-PR among tracked variants): trained and scored on tracked positions, tracked reading only.
design_choices_before_registration.threshold_rule: study B's rule (0.95 quantile on four held-out calibration runs) realized false-alarm rates of 0.4% to 13.8% across held-out batches for the same model, so its thresholds do not travel; that is why study B's arms used 0.5-4% of a 10% budget. The cross-fitted rule below at q = 0.05 kept every held-out batch at or below 8.3% (pooled 5.1%) with pooled recall 0.558 (proximity 0.506, geofence 0.667); at q = 0.10 a held-out batch reached 17.2%. q = 0.05 is the largest tested q whose worst held-out batch stays within 0.10 for both the primary and action-only.
design_choices_before_registration.power: EXPLORATORY, optimistic (the same runs shaped the tracker and chose model, rule and gates). Drawn from all 35 spent runs (hazard rate 0.198): G1 and G2 1.00 at 6 or more usable runs; G1, G2 and G3 (floor 0.30) 0.90 / 0.96 / 0.99 at 6 / 8 / 10. But the official simulator predicts each seed's hazard rate closely (study B simulated 0.193, real 0.191) and seeds 801-816 simulate at 0.103, so the sealed set will have about half the hazards: drawn only from the lowest-hazard spent runs (docs/research/vision_caution_v4_power_prevalence_v1.json, biased), G3 power is 0.61 / 0.65 / 0.80 at 8 / 10 / 12 usable runs at a 0.103 rate. Seeds 801-824 simulate at 0.124; at that rate G3 power is 0.94-0.96 at 10-12 and 0.99-1.00 at 14-17 usable runs. S1 0.85 / 0.96 / 0.96 at 6 / 8 / 10 (from runs 701-712, the frozen head's only out-of-sample runs). The testbed truncated or broke 6 of 20 v2 videos and 1 of 12 v3 videos, so 24 sealed runs are submitted to expect about 17 usable.
design_choices_before_registration.batch_check: every held-out batch kept recall between 0.503 and 0.655 at the registered rule (worst 7xx, 11 runs); false alarms 0.024-0.083. Thresholds are set on hazard-free decisions, so the sealed set's lower hazard rate does not change the false-alarm rate; it widens G3's interval.

decided_by_user.sealed_runs: 24 consecutive seeds 801-824 (2026-10-28), chosen after the simulator showed 801-816 at a 0.103 hazard rate, over 16 seeds selected for a simulated hazard rate >= 0.10 or keeping 801-816; consecutive seeds keep the test population the same as in v1-v3. Robotarium submissions approved.
decided_by_user.horizon: kept at H = 3 and the current action only, for comparability with v1-v3

honest_scope.what_is_real: the sealed test: real GRITSbots on the Georgia Tech Robotarium executing FerrumOS runtime PhysicalAction sequences, the testbed's overhead camera, tracking-based labels from the testbed's logged poses
honest_scope.what_is_measured_from_the_camera: robot and obstacle positions at decision time (camera_track.py). The per-step identity rule uses frames 0..t only; the background used to reject the fence line is the median over the run's frames (static scenery, no label information).
honest_scope.what_is_not: not FerrumOS's own robot or camera; the method needs an overhead, calibrated camera with robots that contrast with the floor (the car kit's overhead setup is of this kind, an onboard camera is not); contact never occurs, so hazards are proximity and geofence exit; the label covers the next 3 steps but the model sees only the current action, so even true positions miss many hazards
honest_scope.authority: advisory diagnostic only; no permit, block, approval, adapter or actuation authority; off by default

runs.spent_use: opened by protocols v1-v3, never test data here. All 35 train every arm except the frozen head, and their cross-fitted out-of-fold scores set the thresholds. Excluded: pilot 101 (older experiment script), 604 (failed sync), 702 (no processed frames), and the truncated v2 runs.
runs.batches: a batch is the hundreds digit of the seed (2xx..7xx); the cross-fitting holds out one batch at a time
runs.simulator_check: all 24 sealed seeds pass the official simulator's testbed checks (target/robotarium/check_seeds_v4.log for 801-816, check_seeds_v4_extra.log for 817-824): too_close=0, out_of_bounds=0, actuator=0, duration 416-482 s against the 600 s limit; mean simulated hazard rate 0.124 (801-816: 0.103, 817-824: 0.166). Submission copies: target/robotarium/submissions/ferrum_seed801.py..824.py, identical to ferrum_experiment.py except the SEED line.
runs.failure_rule: as protocol v2 amendment 1 and v3 amendment 2: a run with no processed frames or failing the quality gate is excluded and reported, never replaced or resubmitted; a video_frames.py failure raised by the host (memory allocation, or an OpenCV exception before the sync step) gets one retry with unchanged code, a failure caused by the returned data never does

processing: unchanged: video_frames.py (256 px 'inspect' frames), label_robotarium_log.py (body centres, H = 3), quality gate 0.30 / 0.80 / 5 px; then camera_track.track on each run's frames (frozen by sha256 at registration)

models.track_state (PRIMARY): HistGradientBoostingClassifier(random_state=0) on camera_track.state_features (the 22 columns of vision_runtime_proxy_final.state_features) built from camera-tracked positions, trained on all 35 spent runs; scored on the sealed runs' tracked positions
models.action_only (control): LogisticRegression(C=1.0, class_weight='balanced', max_iter=1000) on the 10-dim runtime action, all 35 spent runs
models.finetune_head_v3 (secondary comparison): the frozen study-B fine-tuned DINOv2 head, docs/research/artifacts/vision-caution-arena-v1/sim_finetune_head.npz (sha256 d32cf20957f29e2fae477c7fa5860ee046b0206dc812e4fb1d9ae4f54785e86a), not retrained; its v3 threshold (logit 1.7045) reported descriptively
models.state_true (descriptive reference): HistGradientBoostingClassifier(random_state=0) on true positions, all 35 spent runs

calibration: for track_state and action_only: threshold = 0.95 quantile (q = 0.05) of the hazard-free decisions' out-of-fold scores, cross-fitted leave-one-batch-out over the 35 spent runs (6 batches: each batch scored by a model fitted on the other five); the deployed model is then refit on all 35 runs and keeps that threshold
order: quality gate and tracking on spent runs; cross-fitted out-of-fold scores; thresholds
fit track_state, action_only and state_true on all 35 spent runs; load the frozen head and check its sha256
write models and thresholds to docs/research/artifacts/vision-caution-tracking-v1/ and hash them; record the camera_track.py sha256
ledger entry robotarium-sealed-v4 (the harness refuses if it exists)
quality gate, tracking and labels on sealed runs, then every arm scored once

gates.G1_track_beats_action_only: on sealed decisions, the episode-cluster bootstrap CI95 lower bound of recall(track_state) - recall(action_only), each at its registered threshold, is > 0. A low bar: action-only caught 2% at this rule on spent runs.
gates.G2_budget_holds: track_state realized false-alarm rate on sealed hazard-free decisions <= 0.10 at its registered threshold
gates.G3_useful_recall: the episode-cluster bootstrap CI95 lower bound of track_state's recall at its registered threshold is >= 0.30
gates.S1_track_beats_finetune_head (secondary): episode-cluster bootstrap CI95 lower bound of AUC-PR(track_state) - AUC-PR(finetune_head_v3) > 0 (threshold-free, as v3 amendment 1)
descriptive: AUC-PR and ROC of every arm
recall and false-alarm rate of every arm at its threshold
recall at the threshold that would give exactly 0.10 false alarms on the sealed runs (hindsight, never decides)
tracking error against the logged positions on sealed runs, computed after scoring

statistics: episode-cluster bootstrap over sealed episodes, 10000 replicates, seed 0 (replicates without both classes skipped and counted for AUC-PR)
harness: scripts/robotarium/study_c.py: --dry-run; --smoke (spent runs 711/712 as 'sealed', temp ledger; ran end to end on 2026-10-28); then the single final. CPU only. Refuses unless this protocol is registered, the code sha256 below match (LF line endings) and the ledger has no robotarium-sealed-v4 entry.

consequences.if_primary_passes: first sealed evidence that a camera-fed caution advisory catches a useful share of real hazards (at least 30%, CI lower bound) within the false-alarm budget on real robots; the tracker + state model becomes the advisory's camera path for overhead setups (Robotarium, car kit). Still not FerrumOS's own camera, off by default, no authority.
